sentences.en: His coughing was spasmodic, sometimes violent.
sentences.zh: 他的咳嗽是痉挛性的，有时非常剧烈。

sentences.en: The patient experienced spasmodic muscle contractions in his legs.
sentences.zh: 病人腿部经历着间歇性肌肉收缩。

sentences.en: She had a history of spasmodic dysphonia, affecting her voice intermittently.
sentences.zh: 她有过痉挛性失声症的历史，这使她的声音时断时续。

senses.zh: 痉挛的,由痉挛引起的,一阵阵的
